A one-off Fight Night is unique inside the 45-day lookahead so a short name like this is enough; for a weekly series (e.g. Contender Series) the name needs season+week instead, see git history. Discovery pulls recent uploads from each capper channel and keeps the ones whose title matches settings.discovery.title_contains. Add entries to "videos" only to pin a specific video by hand.
